cluster_summary: Shell command injection vulnerabilities caused by inadequate handling of shell metacharacters in either command construction or input validation. One sub-pattern involves insufficient escaping when building shell arguments, allowing metacharacters to break quoting. Another covers allowlist-based validators that miss certain shell constructs, enabling bypass. A third includes missing or easily bypassed input validation.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 2 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Replace flawed blacklists with strict allowlists of safe commands or properly escape/quote all metacharacters before passing to a shell..

mechanism.missing_guard: the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect
mechanism.name: Insufficient input validation for shell commands
mechanism.sink_shape: the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs
mechanism.typical_fix: Replace flawed blacklists with strict allowlists of safe commands or properly escape/quote all metacharacters before passing to a shell.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Replace flawed blacklists with strict allowlists of safe commands or properly escape/quote all metacharacters before passing to a shell.
sub_patterns.name: Insufficient input validation for shell commands
sub_patterns.root_cause: Missing or flawed blacklist-based validation for user-supplied shell commands or content, allowing injection via alternative shell syntax (e.g., other separators, shell escape sequences).
